summary: ADR-0050 accepted 2026-07-29; formal LKG recovery only via publish_knowledge_catalog.py --restore-lkg; recovery requires single-writer lock and validates LKG pointer, immutable generation, all artifact hashes, source snapshot, policy, query report, and current main; ancestor LKG may recover only when indexed sources and inputs byte-match main; restores source snapshot, v2 Catalog, projections, v1 compatibility Catalog, then reruns publication/query/smoke checks; stale LKG never overrides newer main; failed validation or activation rolls back and byte-verifies four layers and pointers; current pointer is final activation marker; pinned-main byte matching required for control-plane scripts; stale lock recovery rules include PID/creation identity, 60-second grace for malformed locks, live/indeterminate owner conflicts; pruning is separate explicit prune_knowledge_generations.py --prune; protects current, LKG, and five newest valid successful main generations; validity uses complete manifest/artifact/layer/policy/source/query checks, never mtime; invalid/uncommitted/unrecognized generations are retained and reported; pruning requires canonical current-main policy, persisted intent, per-generation authorization, atomic isolation, and per-target evidence; failure evidence append-only under logs/knowledge-context and outside pruning; extends ADR-0048, complements and does not supersede ADR-0044/0048; retention policy versioned and ADR-governed; repository authority and consumer freeze points unchanged
